stops.title: The class
stops.caption: Four weeks, and what it confers.
stops.speech: Membership is the four-week class. Completing it is what formally makes somebody a Member, however long they have been attending.

stops.title: Cohorts
stops.caption: Intakes, marks and graduation.
stops.speech: A cohort is one intake. You schedule its four sessions, mark attendance and the final test, and graduate the people who passed.
